briefing: Elite: The Thunder Gate Opens Back. Thunder Gate Covenant: Covenant Stand: the squad can bind damage together, but poor spacing turns shared courage into shared risk.

missionIntro.speaker: Asgardian Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The oath is not decoration under elite pressure. It is the weight we choose to carry.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: The field answers courage with pressure; every vow spoken here leaves a mark in iron.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Take the hit only if the counterstroke matters. Valhalla rewards committed timing, not noise.

victory.speaker: Asgardian Titan Voice
victory.text: The bridge remembers we stood. Let the Gate choke on that memory.

defeat.speaker: Asgardian Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back. An oath wasted is a weapon handed to the wound.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Thunder Gate Covenant records how Asgardian law treats courage as responsibility, not fuel for the Gate.
